description: Will buyer agents pick my x402 API for one task? The single-task panel is the Machine Buyer Panel for buyers under a dollar cap: buyer-agent models choose between your offer and its real Bazaar rivals for one task, across personas and list positions. Returns your win rate with confidence intervals, why you lost, and the proof arm (does a Fair Offer block or an attested sample lift your pick rate). No drafted edits; the full panel tests those. Price: $0.25 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Failed calls aren't charged.
